title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
sourceTitle: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
synopsis: A work-farm transfer, a card table, a fishing trip, and a quiet Indian by a window who has been listening the whole time.

nodes.text: Chief lifts the sink and walks out into a morning that smells of cut grass. Somewhere, you are running with him. Somewhere else, you are at rest.
The men learn poker. They learn it well. They lose a thousand games to each other and not one to the house, ever again.
He goes back to Canada through fields nobody owns. He talks now. Mostly to a stranger he keeps in his head, in a leather jacket, smiling like a mouth full of cards.
